commits.author: Filip Cygan
commits.message:
Apply @Valid to list type arguments instead of containers (#465) (#478)

Hibernate Validator 9.1 (Spring Boot 4.1) deprecates @Valid on a
container and logs HV000271 for each such property at startup. Moving
the annotation to the type argument keeps the same element cascading.
